guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Sign Up on the Sweep Airdrop Page
guide.description: Visit the Sweep airdrop page and create an account using Google, X, email, or a connected wallet. Registration is free and takes under a minute.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Verify Your Account
guide.description: Complete email, and KYC verification from your dashboard. Each verification level awards XP on its own, and a verified account keeps you eligible for the final distribution.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Complete the Social Media Tasks
guide.description: Work through the social tasks in the campaign dashboard, such as following Sweep’s official channels. Finished tasks credit XP automatically, though some rewards take a short while to appear.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Play Sweepbird Every Day
guide.description: Open Sweepbird and play at least one round daily. A single game keeps your streak alive, and streak milestones unlock Bird Tier badges that add XP to your account permanently. You can also earn additional XP by finishing in the Top 100 of the Sweepbird leaderboard, which refreshes daily.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Invite Friends With Your Referral Link
guide.description: Grab the referral link from your dashboard and share it. Invites are repeatable, so each friend who signs up and participates keeps adding to your total.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Make Eligible Purchases (Optional)
guide.description: Qualifying purchases can also award XP. Purchase-related tasks will become available once Phase 3 of the fairlaunch is active. Check the campaign dashboard for updates and eligibility details.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Check Back for New Tasks and Events
guide.description: Sweep adds campaign tasks and special events while the airdrop runs. A quick daily look at the dashboard catches new XP sources early.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
